assumptions: Wall representative plane = measured pixel line centrelines/outer faces from pixel_profile scans, not nominal 240mm offsets.

Window/door heights: North window sill1.0/head3.4m, South windows sill1.0/head2.8m (directly measured from elevations). East/West window heights assumed equal to North pattern (sill1.0/head3.4m) since exact per-opening E/W sill/head was not independently re-derived.
All doors assumed 2.4m height, base 0 (floor level); a 200mm sub-dimension near doors in elevations is treated as threshold/frame annotation, not a raised sill.
Building height 4.5m used uniformly as the single floor's wall height per all four elevations.

South-east area (former corridor-S + rooms E4/E5 furniture zones) modeled as one open room: pixel evidence showed no full-height dividing wall spanning the whole width there (only a partial, non-connecting wall fragment near x440-560,y698 which was omitted because it does not touch both sides and cannot form a valid separate enclosed room under the polygon compiler).
Room roles (reception, office, boardroom, meeting, pantry) are inferred from furniture symbols, not labelled in the source.
unresolved: Fine sub-dimension chain sums did not exactly reconcile with outer brackets (e.g. 4060 vs 540+1500+2380=4420); outer-bracket/pixel-measured boundaries were trusted over the fine labels.
Exact sill/head heights for East and West facade openings not independently re-measured from elevation pixel dimensions; assumed equal to North window pattern.
The partial wall fragment near x440-560,y698 (south-east area) and door there is omitted from geometry pending clearer evidence; the SE zone is modeled as one continuous open room instead.
